simulation.method: Warm-independent deterministic route timings using Node performance.now; 40 independent seeds/runs, 320 fixed updates/run, 12800 updates total.
simulation.route: Five-point authored rail traversing from start through bead to folio seal; each run asserted SOLVED.

renderer.method: Instrumented browser Canvas2D render CPU samples via performance.now; queried live after desktop interaction. 240 most recent frames, one measured sample window.

limitations: CPU callback timing does not measure GPU/compositor time or guarantee whole-frame latency.
Renderer sample window is the live browser experience, not a broad multi-device benchmark.
No FPS or target frame-rate claim is made.
